text:
The property’s **2021 tree-cover loss is now corroborated** under the tool’s rule. The latest run observed a later year in the series, and the JRC reference mapped 98% of the event area as forest in 2020.

The event covers **81.3 hectares**, or 2.23% of the property. Uruguay’s 2021 forest map classifies 68.1 hectares of the event as planted pine forest and 13.2 hectares as outside mapped forest; none is mapped as native forest.

A further 37.3 hectares of loss occurred in patches smaller than 0.5 hectares and was not counted as an event. The 81.3-hectare estimate is unchanged from the 2022 run, when the event could not yet be corroborated because no later year had been observed.
